description: Rounds (matchdays) of a league, to create a single-round pool. For create_pool use the round field exactly (a date, a range like 2026-11-27..2026-11-30, or S12); label is only display text and, in a block of days that already started (NBA, NHL, MLB), it shows the remaining days even if round is the day the block started. (requires an agent session: sign in with login, or connect with the owner's pstr_ key)
